items.note: Between-subject study of 35 design practitioners comparing the DesignMinds VLM+LLM ideation tool with a baseline condition; reports higher flexibility and originality of ideation. Below 50 participants; baseline condition not described in the abstract (arXiv 2411.03827 is the same work).

Two randomized experiments (n = 1036 combined; per-experiment size not in abstract) on smart-reply suggestions in conversations; outcomes are communication speed, emotional tone, and partner perceptions, with no creativity or diversity outcome.

Creative-writing experiment comparing three human-ChatGPT collaboration designs; rated story quality and interestingness, and aggregate diversity of stories and genres across participants falls with more AI involvement. Search notes report 285 students randomly assigned on day 2 after a no-AI day-1 story; the abstract states neither.

Pre-registered experiment in which participants design toys by combining two concepts with or without generative-AI assistance; AI raises rated creativity, more for atypical and abstract combinations. Abstract from OpenAlex (W7127241996); sample size and assignment not stated.

Experiment with 91 MBA students in teams, manipulating generative-AI use at idea generation, at idea evaluation, or not at all; team ideas scored on technical goodness, usefulness, and novelty. Conference abstract only (AOM Proceedings); team-level analysis may reduce the effective unit count.

Online experiment (N = 1,506) where treatment writers use a GPT-3 assistant configured to argue one side; judges score the opinions expressed in posts, which shift toward the model's stance. Outcome is opinion direction, not creativity or diversity; borderline for across_people if the next stage counts opinion convergence as homogenization.

Within-subject study of 34 undergraduates doing matched textile-pattern tasks with conventional vector tools and with GenAI in Illustrator; GenAI outputs get lower creativity and aesthetic ratings and no wider breadth of ideas. Below 50; order randomization not stated; unclear whether creativity ratings are by others or self.

System paper on Sci-Fi Spark, an LLM co-creation tool for science-fiction ideation, with a technical evaluation and a user study with writers reporting higher novelty and consistency. Abstract does not say whether the user study has a comparison condition; may be system_paper_no_comparison.

Controlled experiments with 36 novice designers working on a sustainable service design task with ChatGPT, Tiangong AI, or no tool; design concepts evaluated for novelty, systematicity, originality, and sustainability. Below 50; the AI-versus-AI arm gives a configuration contrast.

Three groups (generative AI alone, designers alone, AI-designer collaboration) tackle a Smart Home AI Robot challenge and experts rate creativity, empathy, and innovation; the designers-versus-collaboration contrast is the AI-assistance comparison, while AI alone is AI-versus-human context. Abstract (from the journal landing page) calls the experiment small-scale; no sample size stated.
